LESSON: COMPREHENSION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.4: Comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Comprehension. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: howing singular and plural holding?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise the correct use 271 of subject-verb agreement to form appropriate sentences,
2. appreciate the importance of subject verb agreement in achieving effective communication by the teacher or from computing devices, and respond to questions based on the theme ‘time’ or questions about time..

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Comprehension. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: howing singular and plural holding?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
